title: Mga kapatid… I want to ask everyone here to really pray for the Philippines… hindi lang general prayer, kundi specific — for the safety and enlightenment of our fellow Filipinos and our leaders.
paragraphs: Mga kapatid… I want to ask everyone here to really pray for the Philippines… hindi lang general prayer, kundi specific — for the safety and enlightenment of our fellow Filipinos and our leaders.

Right now, kita natin na ang bansa natin is being manipulated and gaslighted. Social media, fake news, trolls, edited videos, scripted narratives… halos lahat ginagamit para pag-awayin ang mga Pilipino at guluhin ang isip ng tao. Even reports say na grabe na yung online disinformation especially ngayong election season at sa issue ng West Philippine Sea at sa mga nangyayari kay Duterte at sa mga politikal na kampo.

Kaya to be honest, naniniwala na ako na only God can truly restore the Philippines. Hindi politiko, hindi partido, hindi influencer. Lalo akong nasasaktan kapag nakikita ko na pati mga kapatid natin sa pananampalataya, at maging ilang pastors, nadadala sa emosyon at sa propaganda, at ginagamit pa ang pangalan ng Diyos para suportahan ang kasinungalingan at sariling agenda.

Pero kahit ganoon, I still believe God is in control. He is shaking everything para lumabas kung sino ang nakatayo talaga sa katotohanan. Hebrews 12:27–28 reminds us na everything that can be shaken will be shaken, so that what cannot be shaken may remain. At ang hindi natitinag ay ang kaharian ng Diyos, hindi ang sistema ng tao.

Kaya ang prayer ko simple pero mabigat…
na walang mangyaring bloodshed…
na hindi mauwi sa gulo at karahasan…
na protektahan ng Diyos ang mga inosente…
na buksan Niya ang mata ng mga Pilipino para makita ang katotohanan, hindi lang ang propaganda.

Psalm 33:10–12 says, “The Lord frustrates the plans of the nations… but the plans of the Lord stand firm forever… blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord.”
At 1 Timothy 2:1–2 commands us to pray for kings and all in authority, “that we may live peaceful and quiet lives in all godliness and holiness.”

So mga Gospel Warriors… I’m asking you… huwag lang tayong maging commentators sa nangyayari sa bansa. Let’s be intercessors. Let’s stand in the gap. Ezekiel 22:30 — God looked for someone to stand in the gap for the land.

Let’s pray that our people will love truth more than personality…
that the Church in the Philippines will stand on the Word, not on politics…
and that in all these shakings, Jesus will be the only One exalted over our nation.

John 8:32 — “You shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.”
Yan ang kailangan ng Pilipinas ngayon… hindi bagong image, kundi tunay na katotohanan kay Cristo.

Bro. John D.S. Asis
Gospel Warrior
